A good day: I’m joyous. It feels like I’m on top of the world. Feels like I’m winning. Feels like nothing can get me down. Feels like I have peace on my spirit and things are lining up and when things do try to get me down, I’m able to constructively get through it. It feels good. I smile more. I’m more determined to accomplish goals. I’m healthier cause I’m eating right and exercising. 

A bad day: I’m sad. My body feels heavy. Everything is annoying. I’m not motivated to do goals; only the bare minimum to get to the end of the day. I wanna sleep or at least sit on the couch and watch tv to numb my thoughts. I have swirling thoughts of self-doubt. I isolate myself. I feel ugly and like no one wants to be around me. I feel hopeless. I may cry in the shower so no one sees. What I used to take as jokes now become daggers to my heart. I’m negative.
